thread:
ana: Great all-hands. Two quick infra questions: 1) if us-west runs out of A100s, do Hosted requests get queued or routed? 2) how will burst capacity affect billing visibility?

kevin: Short answers: Hosted -> smart-route to fallback regions (unless account opts into strict-affinity). We try model-variant fallback first (quantized) before cross-region. Billing: burst is billed same unit price but tagged as 'burst' in usage exports.

leah: For Dedicated customers we respect region affinity by default. We will expose a Console toggle "allow cross-region fallback" for Dedicated clusters.

ana: Can we get an example of the autoscaler pools and TTLs you're testing?

oscar: Here's the YAML we're validating in canary (slightly different names):

```
autoscaler:
  pools:
    - id: steady
      gpu_min: 12
      gpu_max: 120
      scale_down_delay_mins: 45
    - id: elastic
      gpu_min: 0
      gpu_max: 250
      scale_down_delay_mins: 7
  fallback_order: [us-central, eu-west]
  variant_fallback: [quantized-v2, float16]
```

kevin: Notes: steady pool holds baseline for SLA-sensitive workloads. elastic handles spikes. Scale-down delay prevents oscillation. Variant fallback used to avoid cross-region when model quality acceptable.

sarah: Ops note: we're scheduling a canary for smart-routing next week. ops-bot will post the rollout window.

ops-bot: rollout: smart-routing-canary -> start=2025-10-15T09:00Z, cohorts=5%, duration=48h

leah: Docs action: we'll add a "Region & Capacity" section in the Console that shows current lead-times, preferred fallback list, and a short latency expectation note (p50/p95 numbers by pair).

ana: Where will we publish lead-time estimates? Customers ask that a lot.

kevin: We'll publish a short live table in the status page and a static note in docs. Current rough lead-times: us-west 4-8 weeks, us-central 2-6 weeks (spot/opportunistic), eu-west 8-12 weeks. These are procurement estimates and will update as contracts close.

oscar: Procurement is working staggered shipments so elastic pools can receive hardware faster.

sarah: Action items: kevin -> post final fallback region list + SLA caveats by Thu EOD. leah -> draft Console card. oscar -> confirm procurement delivery cadence.

ana: Perfect, thanks. I'll follow up in #docs-review when drafts are ready.
